ids.items: identity for global IDs 1-3765 (all Wii items exist in DE with identical type/row; DE adds 3766-4657)
ids.crystals: ITM_crystallist identical (600/600); save identity encoding unresolved

character.highest_level_exp: keep template (0 on a template whose level is rewritten)
character.exp_accum (Wii +0x2A0): no DE target identified; not written
character.equipment: (index, type) = (Wii box index, box type); inventory slot allocation is identity
character.skill_learned: count of non-zero nodes in Wii rows 0-4
character.links: Wii row 5+j -> DE source id = j-th other character; node value copied
character.link_unlock_index: (unlocked slots - 1); DE also re-derives from affinity at 0xBC240 (monotonic)
character.arts: DE art[id-1] = Wii art_levels[pc_arts.idx] for pc_arts.pc == character
character.palette2: Shulk: [talent] + Wii Monado palette; others: keep template
character.stats/HP/caches: derived; not written (DE recomputes on load)

inventory.serial: Wii serial; DE counter @0x46900+4*type = max(template, max serial + 1)

gem.gid: 0 if Wii gid 3747 else Wii gid

progress.play_time: Wii packed time -> seconds at DE header +0x04

crystal.wii: flags = atr_type<<2 | kind (1 list, 2 drop, 3 crafting cylinder); rank = (w0>>2)&7; effects u16[4]@+8 (>>4); values u8[4]@+0x12; +0x18 = cylinder<<15 | source enemy
crystal.de: gid (list: Wii gid; else 0), +0x14 source, +0x16 rank, +0x17 atr, +0x18 named (drop: 2 if DE BTL_enelist*.named else 1; others 1), +0x19 cylinder, +0x1A count, +0x1C+4i (u16 effect, u8 value, u8 0)

phase2d.collectopaedia: Wii game object +0x3866 bit id (0x8009F5F0, id = ITM_collectlist row) -> DE bit 0x19E9+id
phase2d.highest_level_exp_0xF0: = current EXP (DE 0xBA9CC adds every battle EXP to both; reset at new highest level)
phase2d.achievement_counters: per tier: comp_value if Wii completion bit, else min(group max, comp_value) (groups = runs of increasing comp_value, comp_type 4)
phase2d.inventory_box_clear: template box records replaced by the template's empty-slot pattern before writing Wii records
